description.value: Emandare Vineyard is a boutique, family-run winery perched on a south-sloping hillside in the Cowichan Valley, overlooking Somenos Lake in the rain shadow of Mount Prevost on Vancouver Island. Founded by Mike and Robin Nierychlo, it produces low-intervention, organically dry-farmed, terroir-driven wines from estate and single-vineyard sources using old-world techniques. Visitors can drop into the wine shop for tastings, book a private tour with the winemaker, or take part in a unique wine-and-golf-simulator experience held in the barrel cellar.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully accessible and confirms Emandare Vineyard is an active, family-run boutique winery in the Cowichan Valley with a drop-in wine shop, private tastings, a guest house, and an online store. Wine purchases (bottles) can be taken away from the shop or ordered online, supporting a takeout value. No evidence exists in the website content for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most optional amenities.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible winery and wine shop in the Cowichan Valley with confirmed drop-in hours and an online store. A useful stop for touring cyclists in the region.
